Supervisor must not share the potentially stalled controller interpreter or its stdout/file-read loop. Do not create a broad PID scanner or retry framework.

Persist bounded phase boundaries before/after child creation, Assign, handshake write/flush, stdout announce, each Job query/terminate, child wait, Job close, result fsync. Success must depend on the first captured terminal observation strictly before its finite checked deadline plus natural0/Job0/full pinned pre-post/log requirements. A later cleanup wait, result-file timestamp or terminate-call success cannot supply missing timely terminal proof. Observation after real exit is conservative sampling, not an atomic kernel exit event.
